title: Halibut Poutine
notes: Never leave cooking oil on the heat unattended, monitor its temperature and have a fire blanket nearby.

ingredientSections.heading: Garlic Confit
items: Any type of cooking oil or even lard or rendered duck or chicken fat

methodSections.heading: Garlic Confit
steps: Garlic Confit is simply garlic cloves slow cooked in oil or fat until they are soft and spreadable. The caramelized cloves lose the hash garlic flavour and become sweeter. Make a batch and keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 weeks and add to sauces, salads, roasted vegetables or meat.
Separate and peel 1 or 2 heads of garlic, place in a small saucepan, cover with oil and cook on a low heat for 30-40 minutes or until very soft.

methodSections.heading: Roux
steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan. Add the flour all at once whisking vigorously.
When the mixture thins and starts to bubble, reduce heat to low and cut back on the whisking. Cook until you smell a toasty aroma then cook 2 minutes more, stirring occasionally.

methodSections.heading: Gravy
steps: Combine the cream and chicken broth in a saucepan and simmer over medium heat until reduced by about a half. Add the goat cheese, a good pinch of salt and pepper, and the garlic confit.
Stir through the roux and continue simmering, stirring frequently, until sauce is creamy and thickened to your liking.

methodSections.heading: Fries
steps: Wash the potatoes then cut them into sticks. Place in a large bowl and cover with cold water and allow them to soak for 30 minutes.
Drain off the water, spread out the pototo sticks on paper towel and thoroughly blot them dry.

Heat a few inches of high smoke point cooking oil (not olive oil) in a heavy pot to 150°C (300°F). In batches depending on how big your saucepan is, carefully cook the potatoes until soft, roughly 4-5 minutes. They should not be brown at this point. You just want to start the cooking process. Remove and drain on new, dry paper towels.

Increase the heat until the oil reaches 200°C (400°F). Fry the potatoes, in batches if necessary, until the fries are golden and crisp. Remove them from the oil and drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with sea salt.

methodSections.heading: Halibut Poutine
steps: Season the halibut well with salt and pepper. In a fry-pan with a little oil cook each side for 3-5 minutes or until opaque throughout.
Plate up the fries and halibut, pour over the gravy, top with a few good dollops of goat cheese and garnish with some sundried tomatoes, confit garlic cloves and balsamic reduction.
